classes.name: HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP)
classes.description: Emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil (Truvada and generics), emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (Descovy), cabotegravir LA (Apretude), lenacapavir (Yeztugo).
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill or long-acting shot that prevents HIV.

classes.name: Single-tablet HIV treatment regimens
classes.description: Complete single-tablet regimens: bictegravir/FTC/TAF (Biktarvy), dolutegravir/abacavir/lamivudine (Triumeq), dolutegravir/lamivudine (Dovato), dolutegravir/rilpivirine (Juluca), darunavir/cobicistat/FTC/TAF (Symtuza), elvitegravir/cobi/FTC/TAF (Genvoya), rilpivirine/FTC/TAF (Odefsey), efavirenz/FTC/TDF and generics; cabotegravir/rilpivirine LA (Cabenuva).
classes.plainDescription: A once-a-day pill that treats HIV.

criteria: Inadequate response or adverse reaction to one, or contraindication to all, HIV-1 regimens available without PA.
Treatment-naive, or switching while virologically suppressed (HIV-1 RNA under 50 copies/mL), stable 6+ months, no treatment failure and no resistance substitutions.
Combination necessity: psychiatric diagnosis with adherence difficulty, homelessness, adherence-related complications, or a child/developmentally impaired member without supports.
Treatment-naive with HIV-1 RNA 100,000 copies/mL or less, or switching while virologically suppressed and stable 6+ months, with no treatment failure or resistance substitutions.
Combination necessity: psychiatric diagnosis with adherence difficulty, homelessness, adherence-related complications, or a child/developmentally impaired member without supports.

Cabenuva (cabotegravir/rilpivirine LA) is not printed; likely medical benefit, not coded as excluded. [Sonnet check 2026-10-22: Biktarvy confirmed Tier 3, no PA/ST/QL (p. 54). Cheaper complete regimens exist (efavirenz-FTC-TDF and efavirenz-lamivudine-TDF generics, Tier 2, pp. 54-55) but efavirenz regimens are not guideline-preferred first-line, so Biktarvy stays as a judgment call; Triumeq, Dovato, Genvoya, Odefsey, Symtuza, Juluca are also Tier 3. Cabenuva not printed; likely medical benefit.] [2026-10-22 review: sig replaced with label dosing by indication/titration.]
